main_text.p: eadem tandem serie, ad Hebræos una. C. XIV. de divis. S. secundum LXX, Epistolæ Pauli, ad Romanos una, ad Corinthios duæ, ad Galatas una, ad Philippenses una, ad Colossenses una; ad Hebræos una &c. Idem Cassiodorus passim ad Epistolam provocat ut Pauli Apostoli, & sub illius nomine aliquoties citat, Libro de Amicitia & aliis.

XXXVII. Primasius Episcopus Africanus, Cassiodoro memoratus, divin. Lect. ix. Augustini non discipulus quidem, ut Sixtus, sed sectator, & junior toto sæculo, Præfat. in Epist. Pauli, Biblioth. Patr. Parte 11. Tomis. Decem sunt (sc. Epistolæ Pauli ad Ecclesias) cum ea quæ dicitur ad Hebræos. Et postmodum illos aggreditur confutandos, qui Epistolam Pauli esse negant; si propterea Pauli non erit, quia ejus nomen non habet, nec alicujus erit, quia nullius nomine titulatur. Quod si absurdum est, ipsius magis credenda est, quæ tanto doctrinæ suæ fulget eloquio &c. Præfat. in

page.notes: Page number 129 read from the top right; the printed numeral is slightly blurred. The numeral in "Parte 11." appears as two strokes and may be a Roman II; kept as printed. Some words in the italic passage are uncertain in their exact italic extent; the italic marking is approximate. Long s has been normalised to s throughout, so "toto sæculo" is printed with a long-s form. The page is damaged at the top with ink spots, which have not been transcribed.
